title: Generative creative factory
description: An n8n workflow that turns queued briefs in a Google Sheet into ComfyUI / SDXL generations and placement-ready ad creatives, with a hard give-up on a stuck GPU. Built by Dyaksa.
intro: An n8n workflow that reads creative briefs from a spreadsheet, builds the ComfyUI graph itself, waits for the GPU, and exports finished ad placements. Nobody opens the node editor. Scroll to follow one brief through all 23 nodes.

stations.title: The spreadsheet is the interface.
stations.body: At 06:00 the workflow reads every brief marked queued from the sheet marketing already uses. Always Output Data is on, so an empty queue still reaches the IF and ends cleanly at a No Operation.

stations.title: Nobody touches the ComfyUI node editor.
stations.body: One brief at a time, a Code node writes ComfyUI's API-format graph from the row: checkpoint, prompts, image size, sampler, decode and save. Briefs run one by one because GPU inference is serial anyway.
stations.code:
'5': { class_type: 'KSampler',
       inputs: { seed, steps, cfg, sampler_name: 'dpmpp_2m', scheduler: 'karras',
                 denoise: 1, model: ['1', 0], positive: ['2', 0],
                 negative: ['3', 0], latent_image: ['4', 0] } },
check: One Brief At A Time → Build ComfyUI Graph

stations.title: A brief outage doesn't lose the brief.
stations.body: The graph is posted to /prompt with Retry On Fail, three tries 5 seconds apart. ComfyUI answers with a prompt ID, not images, so the workflow has to come back for them.
check: Queue On ComfyUI · POST /prompt · retry 3 × 5 s

stations.title: It checks every 20 seconds and keeps time.
stations.body: The loop polls /history every 20 seconds. Elapsed time is measured from when the brief started, not counted on the item, because each poll response replaces $json and a counter would reset every loop.
stations.code:
const MAX_WAIT_MS = 5 * 60 * 1000, POLL_MS = 20 * 1000;
const elapsed = Date.now() - new Date(ctx.startedAt).getTime();

stations.title: After five minutes, it gives up loudly.
stations.body: A stuck GPU queue doesn't hold the run forever. The brief is marked failed_timeout in the sheet, #creative-ops is told how long it waited, and the next brief starts.
check: Gave Up Waiting? · true → Mark Brief Failed → Slack

stations.title: Raw images become placements, without the prompt inside.
stations.body: A Python script exports 1:1, 4:5, 9:16 and 1.91:1 placements and re-saves them as progressive JPEG, which drops the PNG text holding the prompt graph. The seed goes back to the sheet, so a winning look can be regenerated later.

stations.title: Briefs with a video go straight to the render farm.
stations.body: If the row names a master video, the workflow posts it to the render farm's webhook: two workflows with a clean contract instead of one doing both jobs. Either way, #creative-ops gets a digest with the count and the seed.
check: Has Master Video? → Hand Off To Render Farm

stations.title: An unexpected crash still reaches a person.
stations.body: Timeouts take the failure branch. Anything else goes to an Error Trigger, which posts the failing node, the error and the execution link to #eng-alerts.

stations.title: 23 nodes and two loops.
stations.body: The outer loop takes one brief at a time. The inner loop polls until the images arrive or five minutes pass. Every brief ends as rendered or failed_timeout in the sheet it came from.

edgeCases: GPU queue stuck (for example out of memory)
After 5 minutes: brief marked failed_timeout, Slack alert, next brief continues
Creatives are logged and announced. No hand-off request is sent
/view returns an error page instead of an image
Raised and reported per image. The other images still process
Read Creative Briefs (Always Output Data) → Any Briefs Queued?
No Operation, and the run ends cleanly
notBuilt: LLM prompt expansion from a one-line brief into structured positive and negative prompts
Vector memory of prompts behind winning variants, retrieved as examples
Brand-safety gate: a CLIP classifier pass for stray text, watermarks and malformed hands
Re-queue a timed-out brief once before marking it failed
